description: Latency budgets for the perf:budget gate (task #115). Prevents backslide first; ratchet down as speed-round work (analyzer-gating, ts-hotspot, worker-pool, etc.) lands. Values are current-reality ceilings measured on the reference fixtures in this directory, not aspirational targets.
notes: l0_ms budgets the time-to-L0 promise from analyzeProjectLayered (pure filesystem walk, no analyzer pipeline dependency).

deterministic_ms budgets total wall time for the deterministic pass (orchestrateAnalysis via analyzeProjectLayered's rest promise), AI phase excluded from pass/fail unless it blows its own phase ceiling.
phases.* budgets come from AnalysisRunLog phase records (same phases KLAURO_DEBUG_ANALYZER_PHASES=1 prints); any phase not listed here has no enforced ceiling yet.
Ratchet plan: tighten these numbers downward as analyzer-gating/ts-hotspot/worker-pool speed rounds land. Do not loosen without a comment explaining why reality regressed.
